title: DeviceCommand
description: Server to kiosk command. The kiosk answers on the event topic; cmdId lets the server correlate the two.

cmdId.description: Server-generated. The kiosk ignores a cmdId it has already executed.

ts.description: Epoch milliseconds UTC when the server issued the command.

expiresAt.description: Epoch milliseconds after which the kiosk must drop the command instead of running it. Guards against a retained or long-queued OPEN_DOOR firing hours later.

issuedBy.description: User id or service name, recorded in the kiosk audit event.

openMs.description: OPEN_DOOR only: how long the door stays released.

activeSlot.description: SET_ACTIVE_SLOT only: which models partition to boot from next.

config.description: SET_CONFIG only. Every field is optional; absent means leave unchanged.
